title: Unnumbered equipment schedule table in Figure 4.12

cell_spans.description: Row 6 ('EXHAUST FAN') has a blank printed NAME cell.
Rows 7 and 8 of the printed grid are full-width merged note rows and are recorded in notes, not as data rows.

notes: Rows 7 and 8 of the printed table are merged full-width note rows, transcribed verbatim here: 'CIVIL WORK IS DESIGNED FOR YEAR 2041' and 'PUMP IS DESIGNED FOR YEAR 2026, IN FUTURE IT IS BEING REPLACED BY HIGHER CAPACITY PUMP.'

RS, D, W and V are printed as bare letter designations in the NAME column. The drawing marks the same letters on the wet well chambers (RS, D, W/V); no expansion is printed in the table, so none has been supplied.
The table is printed inside the landscape Figure 4.12 drawing; the region bbox is in unrotated page coordinates and the evidence crop is read after rotating it 90 degrees.
Sizes are printed with a capital X and no unit; spacing inside the SIZE cells is preserved as printed.
Unnumbered table embedded in a figure; p298-1 is a service locator, not a printed table number.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 200-600 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed page is landscape; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed.
